storia: Jensen Huang's Nvidia comeback: Trump ties, security-risk and chip-smuggling scrutiny
angoli_fatti: Six days after the board said no, one weekend of White House pressure flipped the decision, added nearly $1 trillion in value, and set up a Senate hearing on Dec 3.
The morning after: Huang's all-hands apology and therapy, the board under scrutiny, and the 12-day countdown to three Capitol Hill appearances.
novita_oggi: WSJ reports on the political cost of Trump's loyalty to Huang. Bloomberg reportedly found Blackwell chips in China, which Huang had called too big to smuggle. Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to stop shipping server chips to four countries, per Times of India. Huang hearings in DC are expected, per Business Insider.
